bookkeeping_review.basis: Bookkeeping-only edits, proved mechanically: every changed Rust source is token-identical once comments and allow/expect lint attributes are removed, and every changed Cargo manifest differs only in package description and publication metadata. No executed value, seed, selection or decision changes.

interval_design_review.basis: unrelated scientific assertion; no selected sequential or synthetic-control producer body; same previously published interval method; verified selected item changes only
